patch_description: Restructure the pipeline: enumerate diverse hex-lattice seeds (row layouts, wall-pinned variants, corner-filler variants, deterministic jitter), cheap-refine all with nudge-and-grow, then sort and deduplicate into top-5 distinct basins (center-distance threshold 0.05) and spend the polish budget only there via high-budget SLSQP restarts (maxiter=500, ftol=1e-14) with an exact-growth repair. This drops the expensive COBYLA-style broad polish, cuts runtime, and improves sum of radii by polishing genuinely distinct local optima.
